question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: 

ADBG → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/645b32c0f20624dd47f6aca24de97a91effcb549a20d3f9c4b2d47a3027b81f1.png] 

CFDI → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a3a758ed8652b8bf335f319c1a85e25c06c38bc539f0be960fb5a6e6ced1924.png] 

TWUZ → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8358c624ece3deb6d96504a8b5e62a802ed85ac0fd355fddf42099805b71d07c.png] 

ILJQ → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56232dfefba5aa4e6f21a7d24686501e6bb4101222156cb5a2479ce81c1331b9.png] 

 
• Here, the second number is 3 alphabets ahead of the first number.
 
• The third number is 2 alphabet behind of the second number, and
 
• The fourth number is 5 alphabets ahead of the third number, unlike the last letter-cluster.

 

So, 'ILJQ' does not followed the pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
